# IDEAS/RePEc

> A comprehensive open-access bibliographic database indexing economics and finance research across working papers, journal articles, books, software, and author profiles with citation analysis and ranking tools.

IDEAS/RePEc is the largest aggregated repository of economics research, maintained by Christian Zimmermann and the University of Munich. It provides researchers with access to millions of documents, citation metrics, and personalized research tracking through its MyIDEAS service.

- RePEc network
- Economics research

## Research Collections

- [Economics Paper Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/p.html): Directory of working paper series indexed in IDEAS/RePEc database.
- [Economics Journals](https://ideas.repec.org/i/a.html): Directory of economics journals indexed in IDEAS/RePEc with impact metrics.
- [Economics Book Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/b.html): Directory of economics book series and collections.
- [Economics Book Chapter Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/h.html): Directory of book chapters in economics research collections.
- [Economics Software](https://ideas.repec.org/i/c.html): Repository of economics software tools and research resources.

## Rankings & Metrics

- [Economics Rankings](https://ideas.repec.org/top): Economics rankings by citation analysis, downloads, and institutional metrics.
- [Authors](https://ideas.repec.org/i/e.html): Author directory and profiles with rankings and field classifications.
- [Database Statistics](https://ideas.repec.org/stats.html): Statistics and holdings information for IDEAS/RePEc database.

## Personalization & Tools

- [MyIDEAS](https://ideas.repec.org/cgi-bin/myideas.cgi): Personalized user account service for tracking authors and journal series.
- [Virtual Seminar Calendar](https://ideas.repec.org/v): Calendar of virtual seminars and academic events in economics.
- [JEL Classification](https://ideas.repec.org/j): JEL classification taxonomy for organizing economics research.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://ideas.repec.org): Central index of economics and finance research with working papers, articles, and software.
- [Help](https://ideas.repec.org/help.html): Help documentation and FAQ for using IDEAS/RePEc services.
- [RePEc Archive Step-by-Step Tutorial](https://ideas.repec.org/stepbystep.html): Tutorial for creating and maintaining RePEc archives with metadata setup.

## Network & Services

- [Participating Services](https://ideas.repec.org/services.html): Overview of participating services in the RePEc network.
- [Contact & Email Guidelines](https://ideas.repec.org/email.html): Email contact guidelines and policies for IDEAS/RePEc support.
- [Corrections & Metadata Quality](https://ideas.repec.org/corrections.html): Guide for reporting corrections and managing metadata quality.
